about.bio1: Ana Maidana is a Paraguayan creative producer, recording & mixing engineer, sound designer, guitarist, and composer based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
about.bio2: Her work bridges classical guitar and Paraguayan tradition — polca and guarania — through the lens of diaspora and memory. Her thesis became "Entre dos orillas" (2026), a debut EP placing Paraguayan sonic markers in dialogue with Egyptian oud and a multicultural ensemble based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
about.bio3: She founded Nambi Retã, Paraguay's first arts and culture podcast — #1 on Apple Podcasts (2021), 40k+ plays across 60+ episodes.
about.education: BA in Music and Business, Organizations & Society — NYU Abu Dhabi (2022–2026)
